title: Amazon Is Giving You More Time to Shop During Black Friday. Here’s What’s on Sale
author: Les Shu
text:
Get the best Cyber Week deals on editor-approved gear, straight to your inbox.By signing up, you agree to our user agreement (including class action waiver and arbitration provisions), and acknowledge our privacy policy.All products featured on WIRED are independently selected by our editors. However, we may receive compensation from retailers and/or from purchases of products through these links. Learn more.Amazon’s Black Friday deals are a go. Its “Black Friday Week” sale runs from now until November 30 (Cyber Monday), giving shoppers a head start on holiday shopping. To help you sift through the many products, we’ve highlighted some of our favorites below. If you’re a big Amazon shopper, now is a great time to fill those holiday wish lists and spend Black Friday with friends and family.Check out our guide to the best Early Black Friday deals, plus standing desk deals, Home Depot appliance savings, and early tech deals.Updated November 24: We’ve updated this story with more deals on products we’ve tested and recommend.Jump ToMacBook Air for $1,049 ($250 Off)Apple MacBook Air (M5, 2026)Read more$1,299 $1,049 (19% off) Amazon (13-inch)Sonos Arc Ultra for $849 ($250 Off)Sonos Arc UltraRead more$1,099 $849 (23% off) AmazonApple iPad for $379 ($70 Off)Apple iPad (2025, A16)Read more$449 $399 (11% off) AmazonTP-Link Archer BE230 for $75 ($45 Off)TP-Link Archer BE230Read more$120 $75 (38% off) AmazonShow more4 / 24Best Amazon Black Friday Tech DealsPhotograph: Luke LarsenPhotograph: Luke LarsenPhotograph: Luke LarsenPhotograph: Luke LarsenAppleMacBook Air (M5, 2026)$1,299 $1,049 (19% off) Amazon (13-inch)$1,499 $1,199 (20% off) Amazon (15-inch)$1,299 Apple (13-inch)When Apple raised prices earlier this year, the once-affordable MacBook Air now starts at $1,300. The MacBook Air is still the best Apple laptop for most people, even some pro users, thanks to the M5 chipset’s power and efficiency. This Black Friday deal brings the 13-inch base model to $ 104, close to its pre-increase price. Its 15-inch sibling is also on sale for $1,199, down from $1,499. (Note: The 13-inch MacBook Air was discounted as low as $989—an excellent deal—earlier this week, but has increased slightly. Pricing may fluctuate through Black Friday and into Cyber Monday.)Photograph: Ryan WaniataPhotograph: Ryan WaniataPhotograph: Ryan WaniataSonosArc Ultra$1,099 $849 (23% off) Amazon$1,099 $850 (23% off) Best Buy$1,099 $850 (23% off) SonosThe Arc Ultra is a soundbar that does it right, delivering great all-around performance from a single speaker. Our current pick as the best soundbar you can buy, the Arc Ultra supports Dolby Atmos and DTS:X surround sound to create cinema-quality audio in your living room. For a true surround setup, the Sonos Ultimate Immersive Set with Arc Ultra is also on sale and includes a subwoofer and two additional speakers.Photograph: Brenda StolyarPhotograph: Brenda StolyarAppleiPad (2025, A16)$449 $399 (11% off) Amazon$449 $399 (11% off) Best Buy$449 $399 (11% off) Walmart$449 AppleThe best iPad for most people isn’t one of Apple’s more powerful options, which says a lot. The base iPad runs on the older A16 chipset, but it can handle most of what people use a tablet for: streaming entertainment, web browsing, email, drawing, and even light productivity work. It’s great for casual users, including kids. This Black Friday deal brings the price closer to its previous MSRP, before Apple’s price increase. Check out more Black Friday iPad Deals.Photograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillTP-LinkArcher BE230$120 $75 (38% off) Amazon$144 $103 (28% off) ShopWhile you can often find this router at this sale price, it’s still a deal for the best budget Wi-Fi router for a small home. It’s not the most powerful router, and it doesn’t support the 6 GHz band, but if your needs are basic, it will more than suffice.Photograph: Ryan WaniataSonyWH-1000XM6$460 $348 (24% off) Amazon$458 $348 (24% off) Walmart$458 $348 (24% off) Best BuyWith a WIRED rating of 9 out of 10, the XM6 is one of our favorite over-ear headphones, combining comfort with great sound quality and noise cancellation. This is the lowest price on Amazon; however, it has dropped to this price before. Note that Walmart and Best Buy are also offering the XM6 at this sale price.Photograph: Luke LarsenPhotograph: Luke LarsenPhotograph: Luke LarsenPhotograph: Luke LarsenAsusROG Strix G16 (2025)$1,588 Amazon (RTX 5060)$2,145 Walmart (RTX 5070 Ti)Good gaming laptops are never cheap, and they’ve become even more expensive this year. If you need a recommendation that balances performance and budget, we recommend the Asus ROG Strix G16 with an Nvidia GeForce RTX 5060, one of our favorite budget gaming laptops. We prefer the RTX 5070 option, but it’s nearly $3,000. This on-sale model is more attainable.Photograph: Nena FarrellPhotograph: Nena FarrellPhotograph: Nena FarrellAmazonEcho Show 11$250 $155 (38% off) AmazonThe latest Echo Show 11 is our recommendation for the Best Alexa Smart Display. WIRED reviewer Nena Farrell found the screen bright and crisp, with immersive sound quality. Since the sale price matches the regular price of the smaller Echo Show 8, it’s a good deal—just $5 more than the sale price during Amazon’s October Prime Day event.Photograph: Julian ChokkattuPhotograph: Julian ChokkattuPhotograph: Julian ChokkattuPhotograph: Julian ChokkattuGooglePixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL$899 $699 (22% off) Amazon (11)$1,099 $750 (32% off) Amazon (11 Pro)$1,299 $899 (31% off) Amazon (XL)Shop atBest Buy (All)The Pixel 11-series phones from Google are among our favorite Android devices. Loaded with the latest software and Gemini AI features, the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL are our pick as the smartest Android smartphones. They’re also the only non-iPhones to support Qi2 wireless charging and magnetic mounting, so you can use MagSafe accessories. During Black Friday, you can get all for under $1,000 each—a terrific deal for a flagship phone—and they’re at their lowest price ever on Amazon.Photograph: Julian ChokkattuMophieMagSafe 3-in-1 Extendable Wireless Charging Stand$150 $76 (49% off) Amazon$100 ShopHigh-quality three-in-one charging stands look terrific on a bedside table, but many cost over $100. This one from Mophie is one of our favorites, and it’s 49 percent off on Amazon right now.Courtesy of AlamyPhotograph: James D. Morgan/Getty ImagesAppleAirTag (2nd Generation)$29 $18 (38% off) Amazon$29 AppleThe AirTag seems to be on sale all the time, but no matter—it’s currently the lowest price on Amazon and cheaper than buying from Apple. It’s one of the best Bluetooth trackers. If you can swing it, go for the four-pack.Photograph: Adrienne SoPhotograph: Adrienne SoPhotograph: Adrienne SoPhotograph: Adrienne SoAppleAirPods Max 2$549 $419 (24% off) Amazon$549 $419 (24% off) Walmart$549 ApplePhotograph: Harry RabinowitzPhotograph: Parker HallPhotograph: Parker HallPhotograph: Parker HallAppleAirPods Pro 3$249 $149 (40% off) Amazon$249 $149 (40% off) Walmart$249 AppleMost PopularDealsAmazon’s ‘Black Friday Week’ Sale Event Is Now Live Ahead of ThanksgivingBy Les ShuGearThe Best Black Friday 2026 Deals Are Live, Hot, and Ready for ThanksgivingBy Simon HillBuying GuidesWish List 2026: 27 Gifts for the Visionaries, Explorers, and Early Adopters in Your LifeBy Michael CaloreBuying GuidesThe 44 Best Gifts Under $100 That WIRED LovesBy Simon HillAlongside the AirTag, the AirPods Max 2 and AirPods Pro 3 are also on sale. These are well-regarded among WIRED testers, but we recommend waiting until after Thanksgiving to see if they drop further—don’t worry, they are often on sale.Photograph: Brenda StolyarCourtesy of MoftMoftSnap-on Phone Stand & Wallet$30 $21 (30% off) Amazon$50 $42 (16% off) ShopPhone accessories are aplenty on Amazon, but few look as good as Moft’s. You can pick up this ingenious wallet-kickstand hybrid that attaches to an iPhone via MagSafe, or peruse the rest of Moft’s Black Friday deals.Courtesy of BlinkAmazonBlink Mini Pan-Tilt 2K+$50 $20 (60% off) AmazonYou can expect Amazon’s own devices to go on sale during Black Friday. While Blink’s security cameras didn’t make our short list, WIRED reviewer Simon Hill still thinks they’re worth considering, especially if you’re on a budget. A downer is that they only work with Alexa, but if that’s your smart home setup, it’s NBD. The latest version of its pan-tilt camera is usually $50, but it’s 60 percent off right now.Courtesy of Soundcore by AnkerSoundcore by AnkerBoom 2 Plus Portable Speaker$250 $160 (36% off) AmazonWIRED’s audio editor won’t stop praising Soundcore products, but he’s not wrong: This nascent brand (soon to be rebranded as Anker, its parent company) makes terrific audio products without the premium price. WIRED reviewer Louryn Strampe included this Bluetooth boom box in a roundup of her favorite festival gear. It’s the lowest price ever on Amazon currently, but it’s not the cheapest—keep an eye out at other retailers during Black Friday.Photograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillEcoflowRapid Pro Power Bank$250 $160 (36% off) Amazon$126 $60 (52% off) Amazon (20,000 mAh)This EcoFlow portable battery is WIRED reviewer Simon Hill’s pick as the best power bank for laptops. It has a large 27,650-mAh capacity, which is plenty for charging smaller devices too. It’s great for travel since it’s allowed on a plane, and it has a retractable USB-C cable, so you can leave extras at home.Photograph: Harry RabinowitzPhotograph: Harry RabinowitzPhotograph: Harry RabinowitzPhotograph: Harry RabinowitzBoseQuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen)$359 $199 (45% off) Amazon$359 $199 (45% off) BoseAt $359, the second-gen Bose QuietComfort over-ear headphones seem overpriced considering the competition. But when they’re on sale at $199 to $219 (depending on the color), they suddenly become a great buy. As expected from Bose, the noise cancellation and sound quality are excellent. They are also comfortable, making them great travel companions. Note that the first-gen version is also on sale for $169 (it’s frequently at this price), but it’s outdated, and we think you should spend $30 to $50 more on the latest version instead.Amazon Early Black Friday Home and Kitchen DealsPhotograph: Kat MerckVideo: Kat MerckPhotograph: Kat MerckPhotograph: Kat MerckEufyPermanent Outdoor Lights S4$500 $260 (48% off) Amazon (100 ft)$500 $260 (48% off) Best Buy (100 ft)$500 $260 (48% off) Eufy (100 ft)Gone are the days of putting up holiday lights and then taking them down, only to do it again the next year. These outdoor lights are designed to stay up permanently; when they’re not displaying colorful holiday lights, they can shine white for regular everyday lighting. They work with any smart home platform, so you can control them via an app or a voice assistant.Photograph: Kat MerckKiwibit via Kat MerckKiwibitBird Feeder 2$250 $136 (46% off) Amazon$270 $160 (41% off) KiwibitWIRED Reviews Editor Kat Merck is our resident bird expert, having tested numerous bird feeders and doing extensive research on her feathered friends who visit her home. One of the best bird feeders she’s used is on sale at Amazon at the lowest price ever. The Kiwibit Bird Feeder 2 is easy to clean and has a solar roof for wire-free camera charging. The app even has a handy bird-identification feature to help you determine what species stopped by.Photograph: Matthew KorfhagePhotograph: Matthew KorfhagePhotograph: Matthew KorfhageTyphurDome 2$390 $285 (27% off) Shop$390 $285 (27% off) AmazonIt seems like every appliance maker offers an air fryer, but if you want the best, the Typhur Dome 2 should be at the top of your shortlist. It’s also on sale this Black Friday, which makes this “splurge” item a bit easier on the holiday budget. Our reviewer found it works fast during testing, and it can bake as well as cook a pizza or steak.Photograph: Nena FarrellPhotograph: Nena FarrellPhotograph: Nena FarrellPhotograph: Nena FarrellDysonV10 Konical$500 $350 (30% off) Amazon$500 $350 (30% off) Best BuyAs a premium home appliance maker, Dyson doesn’t make cheap products. Which is why Black Friday is a good time to see what might go on sale. Right now, our top pick for the most affordable Dyson vacuum cleaner is even cheaper—the lowest price we’ve seen yet. It works on both hard and carpeted floors, and its brush system can handle all sorts of debris.Courtesy of NespressoNespressoNespresso Vertuo Pop+ Deluxe$160 $99 (38% off) AmazonLove them or hate them, but pod-based coffee makers are popular for their convenience. The Nespresso Vertuo Pop+ is our recommended espresso pod maker, and the Deluxe model is under $100. It has a larger water tank than the standard version, and the Vertuo pods are recyclable. For more savings on coffee-related products, check out our Early Black Friday Espresso Machine Deals.Photograph: Nena FarrellPhotograph: Nena FarrellVideo: Nena FarrellEufyOmni C28$800 $380 (53% off) Amazon$800 $380 (53% off) EufyWIRED’s home-cleaning expert, Nena Farrell, recommended only three robot vacuums, naming this Eufy floor-sweeping automaton her budget pick. It’s 53 percent off right now—the lowest price ever on Amazon—for a robovac with great suction power and a self-cleaning roller mop.Photograph: Kat MerckCourtesy of De'LonghiDe'LonghiClassic Espresso Machine$230 $150 (35% off) Amazon$230 $150 (35% off) Best BuyWith quality espresso machines costing $500 and more (way, way more), a budget option seems improbable. Yet, this De’Longhi fits the bill. One of our recommended models, it usually costs around $200 or just a little more, but you can snag one for $150 if you’ve been wanting to get into the third-wave coffee game. It’s a great price, but we’ve seen it go as low as $120 in past sales.
